lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.17 - A Look and write

details: Look and write helps students to review how to spell some of the unit’s key words.
Look for correct identification of the objects in the picture, and correct spelling.
“I’m opening a shop selling picnic food! I need your help to write labels with the names of the food I’m going to sell.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.17 - B Listen and choose

details: Listen and choose continues checking the unit’s key vocabulary and structures. Students listen for specific words, then show understanding by clearly circling the  letter.
Look for accurate and confident identification and circling of the correct letter.
“I can’t find some of the food for my shop. Can you help me to listen and find it?”

Heads Together:

Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - A Find the paths and circle

details: Find the paths and circle continues checking word-picture connections. Students show understanding by drawing lines to show the correct path to each picture, then circle the word that matches it.
Look for clear, neat lines and circles, and correct word-picture matching.
“Oh no, the labels we wrote the food names on have got mixed up. Can you help me match them to the right food?”

Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - B Look and tick

details: Look and tick reviews two of the key structures from the unit (“There is/There are” and “Where’s the…?) and prepositions of place. Students look at the pictures to choose the correct answers to the questions.
Look for correct identification of all four pictures, and accurate ticking of the boxes.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.18 - Speaking Stick and complete your picture. Ask and answer. Then stick.

details: Stick and complete your picture. Ask and answer. Then stick. helps students practise their speaking skills in relation to the target language.This strengthens fluency, and gives them an opportunity to demonstrate turn taking skills.

Look for students correctly identifying the objects in the picture, accurately describing where they are, accurately placing the stickers on the second picture based on their classmate’s description, and natural turn-taking with classmates.
“Great work, now we’re nearly ready to open the shop! You can be my first customers. Where will you put the  food you buy?.”
